assets.scope: charred-scar, noxious-caldera, mark-spellblaze, renegade-pyromancers vault (random_filter by name), infinite-dungeon and other faeros.lua loaders (elemental/fire, default-name image, non-unique, no define_as, no nice_tile)

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native shape: a burly flame figure with a tall flame crest and long hanging claws.

Fyrk token already made (broad hulking crimson-scarlet flame guardian, heavy shoulders): the greater faeros must NOT resemble it; it is a taller, lighter, more upright golden-orange figure with a single tall plume and a trailing flame mantle.

prompt_fields.subject: A greater fire elemental seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle, drawn compact: an upright, tall-standing humanoid of flame in bright golden-orange and yellow with a white-yellow core, a moderately wide chest, both long arms held forward at mid height with open clawed hands of flame, a single tall narrow plume of flame rising from the head, an incandescent white-yellow face with two dark ember eyes, and a long flowing mantle of flame streaming behind and beside the shoulders. Taller and lighter than a hulking brute. Blazing and complete.
prompt_fields.contrast: Fire elementals: the plain faeros is a lean X-shaped figure with arms flung wide in bright orange; the greater faeros is the UPRIGHT golden-orange one with arms forward, one tall head plume and a flame mantle (silhouette: single vertical plume, forward claws, trailing mantle; hue: golden-yellow-orange; value: light). Fyrk is a hulking heavy-shouldered crimson-scarlet guardian; do not draw a broad burly body or a crimson tone.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: it drew flame plumes and the crest reaching past the edge of the disc, so the token could not be exported. This time draw the figure markedly smaller and tighter: the ENTIRE figure, every flame lick included, fits inside a circle of about two thirds of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep orange and amber flame with a bright yellow-white core and face; nothing darker than mid tone except the two ember eyes; the flame must not cast orange light, glow or warm cast onto the disc, which stays neutral charcoal. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
